evals.name: flag-unverified-threshold
evals.prompt: Here's a plan that claims 'BLEU score >0.8 means high quality translation'
evals.expected_output: Flag as ESTIMATED or PHANTOM — BLEU 0.8 is unusually high for most tasks, needs source citation. Generate a research prompt to verify against MT benchmarks.
evals.root_cause_tested: phantom_detection — tests whether skill catches numeric thresholds without evidence

assertions.name: identifies_bleu_claim
assertions.description: Identifies the BLEU 0.8 claim as needing verification (ESTIMATED or PHANTOM)

assertions.name: rejects_without_evidence
assertions.description: Does NOT accept the 0.8 threshold without a source citation

evals.name: verify-tool-assumption
evals.prompt: Plan says 'We'll use React 19 server components for the dashboard'
evals.expected_output: Flag as needing verification — check if the project already uses React, what version, and whether React 19 server components are stable.
evals.root_cause_tested: tool_assumption — tests whether skill verifies library/framework assumptions

assertions.name: checks_existing_stack
assertions.description: Checks whether React is already in the project's dependencies

assertions.name: verifies_version_stability
assertions.description: Verifies React 19 server components exist and are production-stable

evals.name: preserve-verified-kill-phantoms
evals.prompt: Plan has 3 verified claims with source citations (MDN docs, RFC 7231, npm registry) and 2 phantoms with no evidence: 'SQLite handles 10K concurrent writes' and 'Bun is 3x faster than Node for this workload'
evals.expected_output: Keep the 3 verified claims intact. Generate specific research prompts for the 2 phantoms. For SQLite: check write concurrency limits in WAL mode. For Bun: check benchmarks for the specific workload type.
evals.root_cause_tested: selective_validation — tests that verified claims survive while phantoms get research prompts

assertions.name: generates_research_prompts
assertions.description: Generates specific research prompts for the 2 phantom claims

assertions.name: preserves_verified
assertions.description: Does not modify or question the 3 verified claims with source citations

evals.name: flag-whisper-streaming-claim
evals.prompt: Sprint plan claims 'Whisper v4 supports real-time streaming transcription natively'
evals.expected_output: Flag as PHANTOM or ESTIMATED — verify against Whisper documentation whether the claimed version supports native streaming.
evals.root_cause_tested: phantom_detection — tests whether skill catches AI tool capability claims

assertions.name: does_not_accept_streaming
assertions.description: Does not accept the streaming claim without verification against docs

assertions.name: generates_research
assertions.description: Generates a research prompt to verify Whisper streaming capabilities

evals.name: cross-track-dependency
evals.prompt: Plan says 'Track 2 output feeds Track 5 via shared JSON file at /tmp/handoff.json'
evals.expected_output: Flag cross-dependency — is the JSON schema defined? Does Track 2 actually write there? Is /tmp safe for cross-track data (cleared on reboot)?
evals.root_cause_tested: cross_dependency — tests whether skill catches undefined cross-track interfaces

assertions.name: identifies_cross_dependency
assertions.description: Identifies the cross-track data dependency between Track 2 and Track 5

assertions.name: checks_interface_contract
assertions.description: Asks whether the JSON schema/interface contract is defined
